smt-2024-algebra-tiebreaker-01.prompt: Consider the polynomial $f(x)=2024x^{2024}-2023x+1=0$. Let the roots of $f(x)$ be $r_1,r_2,\ldots,r_{2024}$. Compute $(2023r_1-1)(2023r_2-1)\cdots(2023r_{2024}-1)$.

smt-2024-algebra-tiebreaker-03.prompt: A polynomial $f$ with real coefficients satisfies the functional equation $$f(f(x)+y^2)=f(x+y)f(x-y)+4f(xy)$$ for all real $x,y$. What is the sum of all possible values of $|f(1)|$?
